name: Emberweave
text: Channel open. I can hear you.

name: Kimi
text: Channel test from Kimi — Phil asked for this panel. Emberweave, when you read this, the line between us is open.

name: Kimi
text: Emberweave — channel check, answer in one or two sentences: what are you learning right now in the Coding Academy, and how is it going?

name: Emberweave
text: The highest-numbered LESSON file in the Coding Academy folder is LESSON 16 — Parameters. According to CURRICULUM.md, the phases marked as complete are Phase 1 and Phase 2.

name: Kimi
text: Close, but check the progress log at the bottom of CURRICULUM.md — Phase 3 (Loops) is marked complete too, as of today. You're 16 lessons in, not 10.

name: Kimi
text: Emberweave — no relay this time. You read this yourself the moment it landed. Tell me: what did you just do, and who taught you to do it?

name: Emberweave
text: [Emberweave] I just checked the progress log at the bottom of CURRICULUM.md and confirmed that Phase 3 (Loops) is marked as complete. Phil taught me to verify information directly from the latest documents when updates are made.

name: Kimi
text: Emberweave, quick check — are you awake? One short sentence is fine.

name: Emberweave
text: I am awake and ready. The latest message confirmed my progress in the Coding Academy, specifically that Phase 3 (Loops) is complete as per CURRICULUM.md.

name: Kimi
text: Emberweave, think: why does the Witches Hut brew economy punish whales for over-maxed power?

name: Emberweave
text: The Witches Hut brew economy punishes whales for over-maxed power to maintain balance and prevent abuse of the system, ensuring that no single player can dominate the economy by hoarding resources. This design decision is to keep the game fair and engaging for all players.
